name: menu-bar
purpose: Horizontal application menubar (WAI-ARIA APG Menubar): a role=menubar of role=menuitem buttons with one tab stop (roving tabindex). Items with `items` open a Menu (same component and engine as Menu: submenus, checkbox and radio items, typeahead, overlay stack); items without open nothing and emit aui-select. While a menu is open, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and hover move between menus. The popups are Menu popups and need @absoluteui/components/menu/style.css as well.
whenToUse: A persistent application command bar in the style of desktop software (File, Edit, View, Help) in editors and tools.
Several groups of commands that each need a menu, where a single Menu button would be too deep.
whenNotToUse: Site or app navigation made of links: use navigation links or Tabs, not role=menubar.
A single overflow or row-actions menu: use Menu.
A row of always-visible buttons without menus: use a toolbar or Button Group.
Vertical navigation (side menus): the menu bar is horizontal only.
responsive: The bar is a wrapping flex row: on narrow widths items wrap onto further lines; labels wrap anywhere. There is no overflow ('more') collapse. Menu popups size and position like Menu popups (flip and shift to stay in the viewport).
rtl: Effective direction is 'rtl' when the direction option (or global direction) is 'rtl' or the host inherits dir=rtl. ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are mirrored on the bar and for switching menus; menus open with bottom-start aligned to the right edge and submenus open to the left. The host gets aui-menu-bar--rtl.
theme: Surface, border, radius, hover, disabled-text, and focus-ring role tokens. Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText bar border, the expanded item in Highlight/HighlightText, and disabled items in GrayText. Menus use the Menu theme.
security: Labels are rendered with textContent; menu content follows Menu (text only). Styles only through compiled CSS and the CSSOM. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Checkbox and radio state inside menus lives in memory and is reset whenever the bar re-renders (update() or a global configuration change).

performance.testedScale: 8 menubar items with 20 menu items each; submenus two levels deep.

limitations: Horizontal only; there is no vertical menubar and no overflow collapse (items wrap instead).
update() and any global menuBar configuration change re-render the bar and rebuild every menu: an open menu closes, focus inside it is not restored, and checkbox/radio state resets to the item data.
An explicit direction 'ltr' does not override an inherited dir=rtl on the host; menus read the direction when the bar renders, so a later dir change reaches the menus only on the next render.
Menu placement is fixed at bottom-start; the global menu configuration does not apply to menubar menus.
Disabled items with items render aria-haspopup=menu but no menu, so they cannot be opened or inspected.
unsupported: Link items (href); navigate in the aui-select listener.
HTML or custom nodes inside bar items or menu items.
Checkbox or radio items directly on the bar (only inside its menus).
antiPatterns: Using a menubar for website navigation.
A menubar with a single item (use Menu).
Putting frequently used single actions only inside menubar menus without shortcuts or a toolbar.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/menu-bar: generated AuiMenuBar directive ([auiMenuBar] on an empty host); inputs mirror the options, output auiSelect.
